description.en: Lifespan chronicle for DSH: weaves what got done (deliveries), what it felt (experiences) and the stretch summaries into one timeline, injects state/recents/recalled before each model step, and ships a star-sea map plus a chronicle view. Not a fact memory store - this is the fish's life.
description.zh: DSH 生平编年插件：把「事（交付）/ 感（体验）/ 线（里程碑）」编到同一条时间轴上，模型步骤前注入此刻状态、刚发生的与被勾起的回忆，并提供星海拓扑与编年回顾。它不是事实记忆库，是这条鱼的生平。
